empty.title: No contract is in work in hand

help.backlog: Months of backlog per row is Left to bill divided by the row's billing rate. Months of work in hand divides organisation-currency work in hand by the Admin's monthly capacity; other currencies are not converted or included.
help.leftToBill: Left to bill is the value not yet invoiced: the contract or work-order value less invoiced work, before tax. Draft and cancelled invoices do not count.
help.rate: Billing rate per month is invoiced work in the last 6 complete months, divided by the months since billing began (at most 6).
